# User guidance

Technical reference for **Settings / User guidance**. The app shows a short summary;
this page keeps the full detail.

## Global user guidance (page help)

Applies across this profile's chats and projects, including project-free chats. Guidance cannot change
hard permissions, authenticate a server or approve a tool.

## Structured instruction templates

Each Save applies only its adjacent field. Templates enter future model turns; running turns keep their
recorded snapshot. Leave contacts and licenses unset until you choose them. Never put secrets here.
